answer.reason: Only EZR 3:9 tells something Jeshua did, standing with his sons and brethren to set forward the workmen on the house of God; the other verses list his descendants or name him in lists.

clauses.english: stood with his sons and brethren to set forward the workmen in the house of God
clauses.quote: to set forward the workmen in the house of God

doubts: EZR 3:8 names Jeshua the son of Jozadak, a different man, so it was left out.
EZR 8:33 names Jozabad the son of Jeshua, not Jeshua himself, so it was left out.
EZR 2:40, NEH 7:43 and NEH 12:8 only list him, so they were not cited.
